question: Town P is to the south of Town Q. Town R is to the west of Town Q. Town S is to the west of Town R. Town T is to the north of Town S and also to the south of Town U. What is the position of Town U with respect to Town S?
solution:
• Town P is to the south of Town Q.
 
• Town R is to the west of Town Q.
 
• Town S is to the west of Town R.
 
• Town T is to the north of Town S and also to the south of Town U.
